display.purpose: Tab root titles only: Log, Sessions, Summaries, People, Settings.

heading.purpose: Panel titles, nav titles, sheet and alert titles, empty-state headings, family name headers.

body.purpose: Row labels, segment labels, inputs, message box, default text at 17px.

label.purpose: Footers, captions, row sub-lines, status text, tab labels at 13px.

group-label.purpose: Tracked uppercase label above a panel or inside a metric cell, muted ink.

metric.purpose: Measured value in a metric strip cell, monospaced and tabular.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Observed on the sheet only. Drift from the no-shadow world; recorded, not canonized.

shadows.name: alert-lift
shadows.purpose: Observed on the alert only. Drift from the no-shadow world; recorded, not canonized.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for panel expansion and disclosure chevrons (200ms).

motion.name: sheet-up
motion.purpose: Sheet rise and scrim fade; 150ms linear fade under reduced motion.

motion.name: push-in
motion.purpose: Pushed screen slide from the right; 150ms fade under reduced motion.

motion.name: expand
motion.purpose: Panel opens along one axis (height) only; no transform.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Loading bars pulse between 0.5 and 1 opacity; off under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Metric figures 17px, tab labels 12px, tighter cell padding.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Column carries a 1px seam on each side.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Column 800px; tab bar becomes a 200px left rail.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen, docked above the tab bar or inline.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 6px; background: #0969da; color: #ffffff; font: 600 17px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0969da; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A second action beside a primary button in a footer.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: #eef1f4; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; color: #0969da; font: 600 17px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0969da; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: A destructive action on its own: outlined, full width, 24px clear of what comes before.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #cf222e; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #cf222e; font: 600 17px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cf222e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Two or three mutually exclusive options (Swim/Math, Full/Half, Student/Family/Subject).
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; height: 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #d0d7de; } .ds-seg-item { padding: 0 12px; font: 17px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1f2328; background: transparent; } .ds-seg-item[aria-checked='true'] { background: #eef1f4; color: #0969da; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #0969da; } .ds-seg-item:first-child { border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px; } .ds-seg-item:last-child { border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; }

components.name: Metric Strip
components.description: Three measured values side by side, divided by 1px seams; figures in the monospaced face.
components.css: .ds-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); background: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-metric { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-height: 72px; padding: 10px 12px 12px; border-left: 1px solid #d0d7de; } .ds-metric:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-metric-label { font: 600 12px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #59636e; } .ds-metric-value { font: 400 20px/1.2 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #1f2328; }

components.name: Grouped Row
components.description: A row inside a panel: label left, muted value right, 1px seam between rows.
components.css: .ds-group { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; background: transparent; border: 0; text-align: left; font: 400 17px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1f2328; } .ds-row:active { background: #eaeef2; } .ds-row-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-value { max-width: 60%; text-align: right; color: #59636e; }

components.name: Send Checklist
components.description: Signature strip: Check, Message, Sent, each stage a drawn glyph with a detail line, derived from stored state.
components.html:
1. CheckAll sessions checked
  2. MessageChanged since sent
  3. SentNot sent
components.css: .ds-checklist { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-stage { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 12px 14px; border-left: 1px solid #d0d7de; min-width: 0; } .ds-stage:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-stage-title { font: 600 12px/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #59636e; } .ds-stage-detail { margin-top: 4px; font: 400 15px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1f2328; } .ds-stage.attention .ds-stage-detail { color: #8a5700; } .ds-stage.idle .ds-stage-detail { color: #59636e; }

narrative.overview: Lesson Ledger is a working ledger for one instructor's hours. It sits on a graphite ground, and every panel is one step lighter than the ground and divided from its neighbours by a 1px seam. There are no shadows at rest. Colour is only ever state: blue is actionable, green is sent or done, amber is something to check or changed since sent, red is destructive and always outlined and isolated by space. Two subject tags (Swim cyan, Math violet) are the only other colour. Measured values set in a monospaced tabular face. The signature is the send checklist: Check, Message, Sent, drawn from stored state.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, panels one elevation step up, separated by 1px seams.
Colour appears only for state, plus the two subject tags.
Measured values in the monospaced face; labels in tracked small caps in muted grey.
Flat at rest; depth by tonal step and seam.
Standard iOS controls with a graphite skin.
Light theme is the same system on cool paper; dark graphite is the evening default.

rules.name: The State Is The Colour Rule
rules.body: Colour names a state (actionable, sent, changed, destructive) or a subject. A decorative accent does not exist in this system.

rules.name: The One Seam Rule
rules.body: Panels are separated by a 1px seam at the hairline width (0.5px on 2x screens), never by a shadow or a second colour.

rules.name: The Figures Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Any value measured in time, minutes, hours or money sets in the monospaced face with tabular numerals. Labels and words never do.

rules.name: The Tracked Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking is used only on the label of a panel or a metric cell, in muted ink, and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: A panel, row, cell or control gets no shadow. Its depth is the tonal step and the seam.

rules.name: The Seam Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: A divider is a 1px line in Seam colour, not a drop shadow.

dos: Do use Actionable Blue only for something the instructor can press, and Sent Green, Changed Amber, Destructive Red only for their state.
Do set every measured value (a time, minute, hour, or amount) in the mono face with tabular figures.
Do separate panels with a 1px Seam and a tonal step, not a shadow or a second colour.
Do keep destructive actions as an outlined button set 24px clear of other controls, never inside a panel.
Do keep the send checklist derived from stored state, and use the same three stages on the family summary and on the Summaries row.
Do limit motion to panels expanding along one axis and to sheets and pushed screens sliding in; respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't add a shadow to a panel, row, chip, or control. The only permitted lift is the existing overlay on a sheet or alert (see the drift note).
Don't use colour decoratively. Colour names a state or a subject; no accent exists for ornament.
Don't add a decorative icon, kicker, or eyebrow above a heading. The tab icons and the send checklist glyphs are the only drawn icons, and each names a function or a state.
Don't use the system display face for titles; titles use the monospace, as the Log, Sessions, Summaries, People and Settings tabs do.
Don't add a new spacing step, radius, or type size to match a one-off; use the scale and the observed sizes (34, 20, 17, 15, 13, 12px).
Don't set a monospace face on labels or words; it is for figures and the display title only.
